author: 3owj
content: Fixed two bugs: (1) pdftotext arg order was reversed — passed '- path -' instead of 'path -', causing extraction to fail silently; (2) WorkspaceParams missing skill_variant field — copy_instruction_files was reading config.skill_variant instead of the runtime-derived variant, so --backend agy with default Claude config would write CLAUDE.md to the workspace instead of GEMINI.md
